name: @gobing-ai/spur
description: Spur — a local-first harness engineering toolkit that wraps mainstream coding agents with constraint checking, workflow orchestration, and history analytics.
author: Robin Min <minlongbing@gmail.com>

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && find apps packages -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && mkdir -p dist
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur' build && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur-server' build && bun run --filter '@gobing-ai/spur-web' build
scripts.autofix: bun run format && bun run typecheck
scripts.refresh-plugin: claude plugin uninstall sp@spur -y && rm -rf ~/.claude/plugins/cache/spur && claude plugin marketplace update spur && claude plugin install sp@spur && superskill install sp --marketplace .claude-plugin
scripts.test-pre-check: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-pre-check --fail-on warning --verbose
scripts.test-post-check: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-post-check --fail-on warning --verbose
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.spur-check: bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check && bun run test && bun run test-post-check
scripts.test-pre-check:full: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-pre-check --fail-on warning --verbose
scripts.test-post-check:full: bun run apps/cli/src/index.ts rule run --preset recommended-post-check --fail-on warning --verbose
scripts.check:full: bun run lint && bun run test:full
scripts.spur-check:full: bun run lint && bun run test-pre-check:full && bun run test:full && bun run test-post-check:full
